sources.coveragePolicy: Explicit non-identity ranges only. Unlisted Job coordinates retain their source edition; no inferred identity mapping.
sources.mappingSource: STEPBible TVTMS Hebrew-to-Spanish-RV1909 alignment, checked verse-by-verse against the pinned Diodati Job USFM and the checked-in NR06 text. Diodati follows the same Job 38:39-41:34 boundaries in this range.

sources.coveragePolicy: Whole native marker units in four independent structures must match exactly. Existing reviewed books and CrossWire exception chapters are excluded. Unlisted coordinates retain source edition; no a/b split.
sources.publisherCacheHashMethod: SHA-256 over sorted structure-root-relative POSIX path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL for each JSON

sources.method: Two reviewed clause-boundary bridges. Diodati Matthew 9:31 contains Jesus' warning from modern 9:30 plus the verse-31 narration. Diodati John 8:40 ends with Jesus' first sentence from modern 8:41, followed by the interlocutors' reply in Diodati 8:41. Native verses remain whole.
sources.sourceAuthority: Rendered NR06 Bible.com parity checkpoint and checked-in source chapters
sources.targetAuthority: SHA-pinned Diodati 1885 source, validated overlay, and exact speechRelocatedTo ledger evidence

sources.method: Same-coordinate identity only for complete native units untouched by existing exception rules; combined lines remain whole. Non-English base stories require fresh hash-bound rendered Bible.com parity. Text similarity is diagnostic, not a gate.
sources.targetAuthority: SHA-pinned traditional source archive and validated overlay
